card.statement:
Consider $x^-(v)=\sum_mx^-(m)v^{-m}$ as a formal power series of left multiplication operators $x^-(m):\mathcal N_q^-\to \mathcal N_q^-$. Then

\begin{align}
\Omega_\psi(u)x^-(v)&=\delta(v\gamma/u)+g_{q^{-1}}(v\gamma/u)x^-(v)\Omega_\psi(u),
\\
\Omega_\phi(u)x^-(v)&=\delta(u\gamma/v)+g(u\gamma/v)x^-(v)\Omega_\phi(u)   \\
(q^2u_1-u_2)\Omega_\psi(u_1)\Omega_\psi(u_2)&=(u_1-q^2u_2)\Omega_\psi(u_2)\Omega_\psi(u_1)   \\
(q^2u_1-u_2)\Omega_\phi(u_1)\Omega_\phi(u_2)&=(u_1-q^2u_2)\Omega_\phi(u_2)\Omega_\phi(u_1)     \\
(q^2\gamma^2u_1-u_2)\Omega_\phi(u_1)\Omega_\psi(u_2)&=(\gamma^2u_1-q^2u_2)\Omega_\psi(u_2)\Omega_\phi(u_1)
\end{align}
card.label: Proposition 6

paper.title: Imaginary Verma modules and Kashiwara algebras for $U_q(\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$
paper.abstract: We consider imaginary Verma modules for quantum affine algebra $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$ and construct Kashiwara type operators and the Kashiwara algebra $\mathcal K_q$. We show that a certain quotient $\mathcal N_q^-$ of $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$ is a simple $\mathcal K_q$-module.
